captures.excerpt_edited: three itemListElement entries removed - two German sole traders and one practice whose company name is a private individual's name. A public repository does not republish those, and the defect this fixture shows does not need them. The remaining entries and the positions they carry are verbatim. numberOfItems was rewritten from 15, the served value, to the number of entries left after trimming, so a mapper reading this fixture is not told there are items that are not in it.
captures.note: Three verbatim slices of the listing page. (1) The JSON-LD the adapter means to read: its script tag carries id="collection-page-jsonld", which the bare-tag regex at src/adapters/remotelyde.ts:53 does not match; and its ListItems carry only @id and name - no @type JobPosting, no hiringOrganization, no description - so mapJobPosting would skip them even if the regex did match. (2) A real job card: the link is /job/<slug> and the card carries the company name and a description teaser. (3) What the fallback at :102 stores instead - a /remote-jobs/<slug> category link.
